shard.name: TeamSpeak 3
shard.description: High-performance, low-latency crystal-clear voice communication server for online communities.
shard.author: TeamSpeak Systems & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# TeamSpeak 3 Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl bzip2 tar ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${TS3_VERSION}" ] || [ "${TS3_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    TS3_VERSION="3.13.7"
fi

DOWNLOAD_URL="https://files.teamspeak-services.com/releases/server/${TS3_VERSION}/teamspeak3-server_linux_amd64-${TS3_VERSION}.tar.bz2"
echo "Downloading TeamSpeak 3 Server from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o ts3server.tar.bz2 -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Extracting TeamSpeak 3..."
tar -xjf ts3server.tar.bz2 --strip-components=1
rm -f ts3server.tar.bz2

touch .ts3server_license_accepted
chmod +x ts3server

echo "TeamSpeak 3 installation completed!"
